news.title: Provost announces leadership transitions
news.summary_en: Several faculty members have been appointed to new leadership positions in the Office of the Provost at WashU, effective by July 1, Provost Mark West announced.

news.title: Karch named inaugural Barbara Burton and Reuben M. Morriss III Professor
news.summary_en: Celeste Karch was recognized for pioneering Alzheimer’s research, advancing stem cell, genomic and collaborative neurodegeneration studies.

news.title: WashU partners with St. Louis to expand CLEAN STL tornado recovery project
news.summary_en: Washington University in St. Louis is formally partnering with St. Louis to expand environmental monitoring and public health research in city neighborhoods affected by the devastating May 16, 2025, tornado.

news.title: WashU Athletics wins Learfield Directors’ Cup
news.summary_en: For the first time in program history, the WashU Bears have won the Learfield Directors’ Cup, presented by the National Association of Collegiate Directors of Athletics, the organization announced June 9. The Directors’ Cup is widely considered the ultimate measurement of overall athletic program success in collegiate sports.

news.title: Targeting tumor metabolism to fight cancer
news.summary_en: Cancer cells are ravenous eaters. WashU’s Gary Patti is trying to turn their hunger against them.

news.title: Vij named inaugural Jeffrey S. and Prue H. Gershman Distinguished Professor
news.summary_en: Ravi Vij, MD, a national leader in the research and treatment of blood cancers, has been installed as the inaugural Jeffrey S. and Prue H. Gershman Distinguished Professor in the John T. Milliken Department of Medicine at WashU Medicine.

news.title: WashU Medicine’s Ritchey receives Gloria White Award
news.summary_en: Julie Ritchey, research laboratory manager of the lab of John DiPersio, MD, in the John T. Milliken Department of Medicine at WashU Medicine, received the 2026 Gloria W. White Distinguished Service Award. For more than three decades, Richey has worked to advance research on stem cell therapies.

news.title: How Thomas Jefferson’s Quran became test case for religious liberty
news.summary_en: Tazeen Ali, an assistant professor of religion and politics at Washington University in St. Louis, says Thomas Jefferson’s Quran confronts us with the question of what the founders themselves knew they couldn’t avoid: Will the promises of 1776 stop at the edge of our own religion, or will they extend to Muslims and beyond?
